'''Glow berry crumble''' is the meal of [[glow berries]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants the Aura intrinsic for 1 minute, making every other creature within 50 blocks glow.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/glow_berry_crumble.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Glow berry mash]], sugar, a [[milk bottle]] and dough. Obtaining glow berry mash unlocks the recipe; crafting it returns the milk bottle's glass bottle.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|8}}. A bell sound plays, and 2.4 seconds later every other entity within 50 blocks glows for 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/soul_sight_apply_glow_60.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
